news.title: $3.79 billion in day-one sales
news.summary: Take-Two says GTA VI made an estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales through the end of launch day, calling it the biggest entertainment launch in history. It also reports 32.5 million units sold before release.

news.title: Rockstar holds GTA VI: The Festival in Miami
news.summary: Rockstar and PlayStation are holding a one-off live music event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate launch, with artists from the game and soundtrack including Travis Scott and Cardi B. Tickets were sold through a lottery.

news.title: GTA VI is out now
news.summary: Take-Two confirmed the game is available today on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, sold through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retailers. It is rated M for Mature.

news.title: Official soundtrack album released
news.summary: A companion album with 34 original tracks is out on major streaming services from launch, with vinyl and CD editions also available.

news.title: Over 17 million copies sold
news.summary: Launch-day reports put GTA VI past 17 million copies sold. Take-Two has since published official figures: see "$3.79 billion in day-one sales".

news.title: No GTA 6 Online at launch
news.summary: GTA VI launched as single-player only. Bloomberg reports multiplayer is expected around late 2027, but Rockstar has not announced it.

news.title: GTA VI scores 99 on Metacritic
news.summary: Reviews landed the day before launch. GTA VI hit 99 on Metacritic, Rockstar's highest-rated game ever.

news.title: PS5 system update required before you play
news.summary: PlayStation Support says a new PS5 system software update is required to play GTA VI, so install it before midnight on November 19. A game update (version 01.002.001, about 602 MB on PS5) is also rolling out; Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes.

news.title: Pre-load is live for pre-orders
news.summary: Digital pre-orders can now pre-load the game: it started November 10 at midnight local time on PS5 and 12 a.m. GMT on Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar says you'll need up to 212 GB of free space, depending on your console.

news.title: Unlocks at midnight local time on Nov 19
news.summary: Rockstar's support page says the game releases at midnight local time on November 19 in all regions, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-load first so you can start playing right away.

news.title: Launch trailer released
news.summary: Rockstar released the final trailer before launch. It was captured on PS5 and debuts "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice, which will appear on the official soundtrack.

news.title: Launch set for November 19, 2026
news.summary: The publisher moved launch from May 26 to November 19, 2026, saying the team needed more time to finish the game.

news.title: Trailer 2 released
news.summary: The second trailer gave a longer look at both leads, more of the state of Leonida, and the game's tone.

news.title: First release date announced
news.summary: A launch date of May 26, 2026 was announced. It was later pushed back to November.

news.title: Trailer 1 revealed
news.summary: The first trailer introduced Lucia and the Vice City setting inside the fictional state of Leonida.

guides.title: Do These First: Chapter 1
guides.subtitle: Easy money and gear in Key Lento before the story moves on
guides.body:
Track these in **More → Tracker → Do These First: Chapter 1**. There are lists for the later chapters too.

## 1. Bank your cash
Open the **BuckMe** app and deposit at an ATM. Cash in your pocket is lost if you die or get busted, and it's also lost at the end of Chapter 1.

## 2. The parrot's hidden cash
- Do **Shirley's rum errand**. She lives next to Jason's house and wants a bottle from **Three Sheets Liquor**.
- While you're in the store you'll hear birds out back. Go around the side and hop the fence.
- Deal with the guards (5–6 of them), then talk to the **parrot** until it mentions the **generator**.
- Pry open the low **air vent** behind the generator for about **$1,400**. There's also a safe in the back room.

## 3. Search for the Skunk Ape
- Read **Kirk's flyer** at **Skeeter's bar in Hamlet** to add him to your phone, then call him.
- It **only works at night**. Sleep in your bed to skip ahead.
- Pays **$1,000**. Other posts say it pays $30K plus a car. That's wrong.

## 4. A silenced rifle
Rob the **Kingfishers compound** in Wetman Bay. Come in by boat near the docks, clear the guards, and open the case on the desk in the waterfront building. The **W-22** has a **built-in suppressor**, so you can take people out without alerting the whole camp.

## 5. Free stamina training
There's a **punching bag under Jason's house**. Workouts raise your stamina, and you don't need the $600 gym membership. Match the pink dial to score 90+.

## 6. Scan everything
Click **both sticks** for Focus mode, and scan animals and cars as you drive around. Both count toward 100% and save hours later.

## 7. Cocaine flamingos
Shoot the pink flamingos with a **black-and-white beak** (the yellow-beak ones are just decoration). Each one drops a package you can **sell to a fence**. They also count toward 100%.

## 8. When Chapter 2 starts: Sunrise RV Park
Northwest of Key Lento on Cottonmouth Lake. There are **three safes** (office, dock building and an RV bathroom), and a unique **Kingfishers Akulus revolver** on the bed in the orange-and-white RV.

guides.title: Do These First: Chapters 2–5
guides.subtitle: The best money and must-dos in each chapter
guides.body:
Each chapter has its own checklist in **More → Tracker**.

## Chapter 2: Port Gellhorn
- **Sell cars to Moses.** After the *Moses* mission he buys untracked cars with **no daily limit**, at $1,000+ each. Steal them on the main road through town, not right next to his garage, and expect a short wait between sales.
- **Rob Sunrise RV Park** on Cottonmouth Lake (northwest of Key Lento). It has three safes and a unique **Akulus revolver** on the bed in the orange-and-white RV.
- **Afternoon Delight** safe code: **2008**.
- **Play pool at Delights** before the chapter ends, because the club closes for a while.
- **Save manually before *Checking Out*.** The motel stops being a safehouse after it.

## Chapter 3: Vice City
- **Race Yago** as soon as his invite shows up. It has an **hourglass** icon, which means it's timed and can expire. First place pays about **$3,800**.
- **Unlock the Key Cloner** in *Steal the Zorrusso for Randy*, then work through **Randy's Wish List**: 16 high-end cars at **$30,000+** each if they're undamaged. Randy marks some, and you can text him for more.
- **Jewelry stores:** rob the cases and the **back-room safe**, then fence the loot with **Yasmani**. That's $10,000–$25,000 per store. Leave before the police show up.
- **Pay 'N' Spray** buys cars with a standard tracker, around $4,000 for a good one.
- **The Cartel Heist** pays **$120,000**. Save before you start it.

## Chapters 4–5
- **Lucia's hourglass call** (*This Is a Free Call From…*) is timed. Answer it right away.
- **Bank vaults** open late in Chapter 4 (*That's Where the Money Is*). Follow an armored van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open, for up to about **$205,000** a run. Rob **2 Payday Loans** stores first and **Yasmani** sells you van routes for $10,000. A vault gives you an instant 4-star wanted level, so bring a fast motorbike.
- **Save manually before *Starting from Zero*** and again, in a new slot, before ***The End of the Road***. There's **no mission replay**, so those saves are how you go back and see the other ending.
- Before the finale, **finish side stories for both Jason and Lucia**, plus any trophies that need both of them.
- **Stock up on body armor and grenades.** The final mission is the longest fight in the game.
- Scanning cars, studying animals and clearing gang hideouts can wait until after the credits.

guides.title: GTA 6 at a Glance
guides.subtitle: The facts now that the game is out
guides.body:
## The basics
- **Out now:** November 19, 2026 on **PS5** and **Xbox Series X|S**. There's no PC version yet.
- **Setting:** The state of Leonida, including Vice City, Key Lento and the swamps.
- **You play as:** Jason and Lucia, and you switch between them.
- **Story:** 5 chapters with roughly 90+ main missions, plus many side jobs.
- **Reviews:** 99 on Metacritic at launch, Rockstar's highest-rated game.

## What's not in at launch
- **GTA Online.** This is a single-player release. Rockstar hasn't announced an online mode or a date. See the Online tab.

## Performance
- PS5 Pro runs it best. Base PS5 and Series X target 30fps. Series S runs at a lower resolution.

[Kotaku launch coverage](https://kotaku.com/live-updates-on-gta-6-the-biggest-launch-in-gaming-history-2000758030)

guides.title: Fixing Up Jason's House
guides.subtitle: An early optional task that makes a good first impression on Lucia.
guides.body:
## When it appears
After Lucia calls Jason to say she's being released, you can patch up his place before you pick her up. It's optional, but she notices the work when she arrives and it helps your relationship with her.
## The repairs
Each job shows a paintbrush icon nearby. Walk up and interact to do it. Any order works.
- **Roof:** climb the ladder beside the front door and fix the tarp-covered patch on top.
- **Steps:** head down to the driveway where the car is parked and use the pile of planks at the bottom of the stairs.
- **Bedroom wall:** inside, board up the open wall in Jason's bedroom, then use the paint buckets to finish it.
- **Railing:** out on the deck by the workout gear, fix the broken railing.
## Tip
Do these while you wait for the call to pick Lucia up, along with the other optional errands for her return. They all count toward a better start with her.

guides.title: Beginner Tips
guides.subtitle: 12 things to know in your first hours
guides.body:
## Settings worth changing
- **Struggling with fights?** Settings → Gameplay → turn on **Accessible Combat** (you take less damage) and **Reduced Vehicle Damage**. Neither one changes the story or blocks trophies.
- **Miss GTA 5's controls?** Settings → Control Scheme → **Classic**.
- **Dark or washed-out picture?** It's usually HDR. On PS5: Settings → Screen and Video → Video Output → turn HDR off and see if it looks better.

## Protect your money
- Cash in your pocket is **lost if you die or get busted**. Deposit it at an ATM with the **BuckMe** app (unlocks in Chapter 1).
- **Family Savings** money can't be withdrawn, but it can't be lost either, and it carries you through the end of Chapter 1.

## Getting around
- **Next mission:** open the map and use the index to list story missions, then set a waypoint.
- **Quick waypoint:** hold **Down** on the D-pad to see nearby shops and missions, then press **R3** on one.
- **Fast travel:** the **RydeMe** app books a ride. Hold Triangle/Y during it to skip the trip for a small fee.
- **Get your car back:** the **Scooter Bros** app delivers your car to you.

## Cars
- Lockpicking or hotwiring? Move the sticks to find the **pink sweet spot** to finish faster.
- To **keep a car for good**, register it at a **Pay 'N' Spray**. You can also sell stolen cars there (daily limit).
- Specialist tuning is only at mod shops with a **blue wrench** icon.

## Play style
- Grab enemies from behind (R2/RT) to knock them out, or aim for arms and legs. Killing everyone makes your **criminal profile** more violent.
- Check the phone's **Reminders** tab. It collects messages from people waiting on you.

guides.title: Making Money Early
guides.subtitle: Best cash methods in Chapters 1 and 2
guides.body:
## Chapter 1
- **Sell drugs to Donnie or Brian.** After *Clean Up After Donnie*, you can sell narcotics at Donnie's trailer. Donnie also sends you package locations to pick up.
- **Hit illegal operations.** Clear out a gang spot, open the back-room safe and take the narcotics. A good first one is the **Exotic Animals Front** in Key Lento, through the hole in the wall behind the **Three Sheets Liquor** store (its safe needs no code). The Kingfisher spots in the northwest swamps work too.
- **Steal and sell cars** at any **Pay 'N' Spray**. There's a daily limit that resets every 24 in-game hours.
- **Treasure diving for Kenton.** He gives you a boat and a scanner. It's slow, and he pays only after he sells what you find.

## Chapter 2
- Befriend **Moses** to sell cars to him with **no daily limit**.
- Store and jewelry robberies open up as the story moves along.

## Don't lose it
- **Deposit your cash** with BuckMe. Pocket money is lost when you die, get busted, or reach the end of Chapter 1.
- **Put at least $5,000 in Family Savings** before the end of Chapter 1. See the guide *Before the End of Chapter 1*.

guides.title: Before the End of Chapter 1
guides.subtitle: Do this before 'Recalibration' or you'll lose cash and your house
guides.body:
## The point of no return
Late in Chapter 1, a chain of missions starts (around **Recalibration** and **Tourist Trap**) that runs straight through to Chapter 2 **with no free roam**.

## What you lose
- **All the cash you're carrying.**
- **Jason's house in Key Lento**, permanently.
- Key Lento side activities (Kenton's treasure diving, fishing with Cal, the Kingfisher hideouts) until later in the story.

## Do this first
- **Make a manual save in a new slot** and don't overwrite it.
- **Move your cash into Family Savings** with BuckMe. Guides recommend at least **$5,000**.
- Finish any Key Lento side stuff you care about.
- Grab Lucia's clothes and gifts if you want them (the optional tasks before *Coming Home*).

guides.title: 100% Completion Overview
guides.subtitle: What counts and how much of each
guides.body:
## Good news first
Nothing for 100% is permanently missable. You can finish everything in free roam after the story.

## Main requirements
- Finish the story, plus **100 optional tasks**
- **39** Gang Operations · **22** Bank Jobs · **7** Payday Loans · **8** Vaults
- **15 of 18** Collectible Card Sets · **15 of 18** Meditation Spots
- **100 of 125** Cocaine Flamingos destroyed
- **33** Underwater Discoveries · **30 of 34** Magazines, Books and Comics
- **100** WAiNK landmark scans · **70 of 79** Styles discovered
- **42** Shooting Range gold medals · **42** Drone Time Trials
- **300 of 397** Stunts · **70 of 80** Challenges
- Scan **200** base-model vehicles · study **100** animals · collect **50** standard weapons

## Tips
- **Scan cars and study animals as you go** during the story. It saves hours later.
- Meditation Spots count for **Jason and Lucia separately**, so do each one with both.
- Real Cocaine Flamingos have a **black-and-white beak**. The yellow-beak ones are decoration.
- Buy the **$5 waiver** at shooting ranges before you try the challenges.
- Do **Challenges last** and pick the easiest ones left.

Counts come from early community guides and may shift a little as players confirm them.

guides.title: Is There GTA 6 Online?
guides.subtitle: Not yet. Here is what we know.
guides.body:
## Right now
GTA 6 launched as a **single-player game**. There's no online mode, and Rockstar hasn't announced one or given a date.

## What's been reported
- Bloomberg has reported that multiplayer is expected around **late 2027**, about a year after launch. Rockstar hasn't confirmed this, so treat it as a **rumor**.
- Take-Two has said it's too early to talk about how an online mode would be sold.

## What happens here
The moment Rockstar announces GTA 6 Online, this tab fills up with heists, contact missions, businesses and money guides. Turn on new-content alerts so you don't miss it.

guides.title: Missables & Points of No Return
guides.subtitle: What to finish before each chapter ends
guides.body:
## How saving works
Story missions **can't be replayed**. Make a manual save before any mission you want to see again, and before every chapter finale.

## End of Chapter 1 (Tourist Trap)
- You lose Jason's house and any cash you're carrying. Put **$5,000+** in Family Savings first.
- Do the **balcony meditation** at Jason's house. It's reported to be the only permanently missable trophy.
- Grab the magazines and books at the house and finish Shirley's tasks.

## End of Chapter 2 (Checking Out)
- The Starlet Motel stops being a safehouse.
- Play **pool at Delights** before you leave. The club closes for a while.
- Go in with **$15,000+** saved.

## Chapter 3
- **Race Against Yago** (hourglass icon) is timed. Do it as soon as it appears or you can lose Yago's whole questline.
- **This is a Free Call From...** can also expire.

## End of Chapter 4 and the final mission
- The story has **more than one ending**. Save manually before the last mission of Chapter 4 and before the final mission so you can see the other outcome.
- Before the finale, finish the trophies that need **both characters**. Your ending may limit who you can play afterward.

## Any time
- **Hourglass missions** are timed. Start them right away.
- Watch your **criminal profile**. Once a character hits *Irredeemable* it's permanent.

Based on early community guides. Details may shift as more players finish the game.

Every cheat in GTA VI has to be **unlocked** before its code works. First you need to **finish the main story**, then each cheat has its own task. After the story, check your progress in **Progress menu → Cheats**.

- Press **Up** on the D-pad to open the phone

- Enter the arrows

guides.title: Crashes and launch problems: what to try
guides.subtitle: Safe steps for PS5 and Xbox crashes while we wait for a patch
guides.body:
Some players are seeing GTA VI close to the home screen, most often on **PS5** with error **CE-108255-1**. It can happen in the opening scenes or a few minutes into play. Plenty of players never see it.

## Where things stand
- Rockstar **hasn't acknowledged** a crash bug or announced a fix yet
- Two updates went out **before launch** with no patch notes, so make sure you have the latest version
- A crash doesn't mean your console is broken

## Try these, in order
- **Update the game.** PS5: highlight GTA VI, press **Options**, choose **Check for Update**. Xbox: press **Menu** on the game, choose **Manage game and add-ons → Updates**
- **Update your console** to the newest system software
- **Fully power off** (not Rest Mode or Sleep), then start it again
- **Keep the vents clear** and dust-free so the console doesn't overheat

## Still crashing?
- Write down the **error code** and the **scene** where it happens
- Contact **Rockstar Support** with those details
- Rebuilding the database or reinstalling is a last resort, and players say it doesn't always help. **Don't factory-reset** your console because of a forum post

We'll update this page as soon as Rockstar releases a patch.
