missions.title: Prologue
missions.summary: Lucia's story opens behind bars, then flashes back to the robbery that put her there.
steps: Talk to your cellmate. Hold **L2 / LT** to pick a dialogue option.
Follow the guard down the hall to the office.
In the flashback, aim at the cashier and threaten them.
Grab the cash, then hit the on-screen prompt when a customer tackles you.
Run from the police over the rooftops and through the garage.
Make your way back to the coffee shop to wrap up the mission.
tips: This is a tutorial mission: it teaches dialogue choices, aiming, and climbing (jump to vault ledges).
There are no bonus objectives here, so just play it through.

missions.title: Gone Fishing
missions.summary: Jason's first mission: a boat run with Cal to pick up a drug drop turns into a rescue when Donnie gets grabbed.
steps: Drive the boat after Donnie's plane.
Slow down beside each floating package so Cal can hook it. There are three.
Use the binoculars to watch the deal at the docks.
Go ashore and search the camp for Donnie. Sneak up behind guards for **silent knockouts**.
Free Donnie in the shack and win the fight with the big guard.
Pick up the Zombix, then get to the seaplane.
Fly to Brian's Marina. Hold **L2 / LT** to slow down and land on the water, then head to the dock.
Drive Cal home, then drive to Jason's house.
objectives: Optional: grab Brian's cash from the trailer on the way to the plane. It's easy to miss.
tips: Expect someone to jump out at you inside the cash trailer.
Stealth earns Professional reputation. Shooting limbs instead of killing helps your reputation too.
Zombix heals you. Keep some on you.
Press **L3 + R3** to use Focus.

missions.title: Gear Up
missions.summary: Jason heads to the local gun shop to pick up a long gun from Andrew, and runs into trouble on the way out.
steps: Check the mailbox outside Jason's house. Mission pay lands there, so grab any cash waiting for you.
Set a waypoint to the gun shop near Jason's house and drive there.
Talk to **Andrew** at the counter.
Open the shop menu and buy a **longarm**. You can pick the shotgun or the tactical rifle.
Leave the shop. Three **Kingfishers** jump you outside.
Take down all three.
Call **Donnie** to warn him about the Kingfishers.
tips: Fight the Kingfishers with your fists. Gunfire draws police attention fast.
Which longarm you buy doesn't change the mission. If you have cash left, spend it on a weapon mod.
Keep checking the mailbox at Jason's house. You don't have a bank account yet, so payments arrive there.
missions.rewards: A shotgun or tactical rifle of your choice

missions.title: Just a Scratch
missions.summary: Jason takes his beat-up Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care for a free repair and paint job.
steps: Drive Jason's Ganado to **Coastal Auto Care** near his house.
Talk to **Joey** outside the garage.
Pull the car into the garage once the door opens.
In the repair menu, choose the **full engine** repair. It's free.
Go to Cosmetics, then Respray, and pick any color. The respray is free too, and the mission ends.
tips: You keep this car for the rest of Chapter 1 but it gets replaced later, so don't sink much money into upgrades.
A respray is a quick way to shake police who know your car. Remember this shop when you have heat on you.

missions.title: Lab Fees
missions.summary: Brian sends Jason to collect overdue rent from a shop tenant in Key Lento who has no intention of paying.
steps: Drive to the marker at the small shop tucked behind the surf shop in Key Lento.
Ask the clerk behind the counter for Brian's rent.
When he refuses, lean on him until he backs down.
Open the back room with keypad code **0420**.
Grab the acid from the back room.
Call Brian to find out where to drop it.
Drive to Brian's lockup in the southern Keys, enter code **7700** and stash the acid inside.
tips: Remember code 7700. Brian's lockup is also where you can offload drugs you find later for cash.

missions.title: Unwanted Attention
missions.summary: Cal sends Jason to pull a red Imponte Phoenix out of the Hamlet police impound and get it to a garage without the cops tracing it.
steps: Meet Cal on the north side of Key Lento and ride with him to Hamlet. He adds a **police scanner** app to your phone.
Climb the impound fence instead of breaking it, then crouch and use the containers to reach the red Phoenix.
Get in the tow truck and unhook the Phoenix, then get in the Phoenix.
Roll up to the main gate and wait for it to open.
Floor it and lose the police.
Respray the Phoenix at the Pay 'n' Spray in Hamlet.
Park it in the marked garage and grab the **$150** inside.
Spend the cash on new clothes at the gun store next door and change to shake off the heat.
tips: Stay sneaky in the impound. Breaking the fence or knocking out guards puts the police on alert.
Police remember your car and clothes. A respray or a change of outfit helps you get away clean.
After the mission, wait for the heat to die down. Cal texts you about the payment once it does.

missions.title: Pipework
missions.summary: Jason stops by to collect a tenant's rent, but she won't hand it over until he fixes her blocked sink.
steps: Drive to Mandy's house and talk to her out front.
Follow her inside.
Grab the plunger from the bathroom.
Go to the blocked sink and plunge it with **R3 / RS**.
Use the wrench on the pipe under the sink to finish clearing it.
Head out once the job is done.
tips: Plunger first, wrench second: the wrench step only comes up once the sink has been plunged.

missions.title: Hey Arnold!
missions.summary: Brian's broker Arnold has gone quiet, so Jason and Cal ride along with Brian to track him down in Maroon Key.
steps: Meet Brian at the pool bar in southern Key Lento.
Get in the driver's seat of Brian's truck.
Drive to the nearby liquor store and pick up Cal.
Head south to the search area near the Radar Station in Maroon Key and take the first left to find Arnold.
When the meeting goes wrong, chase Arnold's car and fight off the men on motorcycles.
Keep after him across the broken bridge; the jumps there trigger automatically.
Follow Arnold on foot once he ditches the car and corner him at the docks.
Decide whether to **kill** or **spare** Arnold.
If you fired a gun, leave the area before the police show up.
tips: Aim from the truck with **L1 / LB**, fire with **R1 / RB**, and click **L3 + R3** together to slow time for easier shots.
Shooting out a tire on Arnold's car can end the car chase early.
The kill-or-spare choice doesn't change how the mission ends, but it can count toward Jason's criminal profile.

missions.title: Island Dreams
missions.summary: Kenton, who runs a beach dive shop, offers Jason the use of his boat and scuba gear in exchange for guiding a group of tourists on a wreck dive.
steps: Meet Kenton at his Island Dreams shop by the beach.
Take the boat out to the marked spot offshore.
Put on the scuba gear at the back of the boat and dive in.
Lead the tourists through the underwater trench to the shipwreck.
Equip the **metal detector** from the weapon wheel and sweep the search area until it turns green.
Collect the treasure on the seabed.
Free the stuck diver at the wreck.
Deal with the **shark** on the way back using the harpoon gun.
Swim back up to the boat to finish.
tips: Keep an eye on the oxygen bar in the top-left corner.
Click **L3 / LS** to swim faster underwater.
The shark goes down quicker if you stay close, since harpoon shots drop off over distance.
You can return to wrecks later to look for more treasure, and Kenton's boat and gear stay available to you.
missions.rewards: Access to Kenton's shop, boat and diving gear

missions.title: Feng Shui
missions.summary: A low-key mission at Jason's house: Cal helps rearrange the living room, then the two unwind with some video games.
steps: After Island Dreams, wait for the text and head to Jason's house in Key Lento.
Go inside to start the mission, then sit on the couch.
Move the TV, coffee table, couch and chair to where Cal suggests.
Play **Tenebrae Lux** with Cal until it ends.
Play **Street Trash III** until it ends.
tips: It doesn't matter whether you accept the coffee table spot or keep moving it; the result is the same.
Neither video game can be won, so don't stress about your score. They end on their own.

missions.title: Coming Home
missions.summary: Lucia is finally released, and Jason picks her up and takes her out to celebrate with friends. The night doesn't stay calm for long.
steps: Optional: run errands for Lucia's return, like picking up her clothes, a gift and flowers, and getting a haircut.
When Lucia calls, drive to the prison and check in with the guard at reception.
Meet Lucia outside and get in the car together.
Drive to **The Rusty Anchor** bar and head inside.
Order drinks, then find Lucia and talk to her.
Mingle with your friends at the bar.
Dance with Lucia if you want to.
Play a game of pool with Mattia.
Take the confrontation outside and win the fistfight.
Run from the police with Lucia to finish.
tips: The pre-mission errands and the house repairs are optional, but they give Jason and Lucia's relationship a better start.
Accepting the dance gives a small relationship boost.
In the fight, block when your opponent starts winding up, then hit back.

missions.title: Buck Me
missions.summary: Jason tries to open a bank account and ends up with the BuckMe app instead.
steps: After Lucia calls, drive to the **Fleeca** bank in Key Lento.
Ask the teller about opening an account.
Talk to the manager and follow him into his office.
Watch the cutscene back at home.
Open your phone and launch the **BuckMe** app.
From the checking account, move the $100 welcome deposit into **Family Savings**.
tips: Money in Family Savings can't be withdrawn, but you also can't lose it.
You can deposit cash at ATMs through BuckMe, which protects it if you die.
Reaching savings goals unlocks discounts and raises your checking limit.

missions.title: Clean Up After Donnie
missions.summary: One of Donnie's drug drops went missing in the swamp. Track it down, take it back from the Kingfishers and bring it to his trailer.
steps: Drive to the search area by the river in the Hamlet swamps.
Ask the fisherman on the dock, then **inspect the spot** where the package was.
Take the boat parked nearby downriver to the **Kingfisher shack**.
Take out the Kingfishers and grab the package from inside the shack.
Fight off the Kingfishers who come after you by boat.
Bring the package back to **Donnie's trailer** in Key Lento and drop it in his container out back.
tips: Clear the Kingfishers fast: the boat gives you very little cover.
Look for a sniper rifle in the shack. It makes the boat fight much easier.
After this mission you can sell drugs to Donnie at his trailer, one of the best early ways to make money.
missions.rewards: About $600, paid later by mail (check Jason's mailbox). Unlocks selling to Donnie.

missions.title: Down to Earth
missions.summary: A boat-cleaning favor for Brian turns into a seaplane smuggling run with Lucia, and you have to beat her parole officer home.
steps: Meet Brian at his marina.
Pressure-wash the boat until all the grime is gone.
Board the seaplane with Lucia and fly to the marked pickup in the northwest.
Land on the water near the boat and pick up the package.
Deal with the smugglers when the deal goes bad.
Fly to each drop point and land on the water (Lucia handles the drops).
Fly back, land near the dock and hurry home: Lucia's **parole officer** is on the way.
Hide the drugs in the **washing machine** under the house.
Join Lucia while she talks to the parole officer.
tips: Ease onto the water slowly. Hitting it too hard destroys the plane and fails the mission.
If you land a little short, you can taxi across the water to the marker.
Shooting enemies in the arms and legs instead of killing them keeps your criminal profile less violent.
After the cutscene Lucia shows you how to **meditate**, which unlocks the first Meditation Spot collectible.

missions.title: Clear Skies
missions.summary: Fly with Donnie to escort a drug plane. The handoff turns into an ambush by a biker gang and you have to get Donnie out alive.
steps: Meet Donnie at his seaplane, then find **Brian at the bar** up the street.
Take off from the water and fly to the intercept point out over the ocean.
Find **Pilot Pete** and fly right above his plane to escort him to the swamp airstrip.
Fly to the second airstrip and land carefully.
Head to the deal on foot. When it's ambushed, take out the bikers.
Clear the buildings along the strip and **free Donnie**.
Cover Donnie while he gets to the plane.
Grab a bike and chase down Donnie's plane at the meeting point.
Back at home, help Lucia build the coffee table.
tips: Destroying the plane on landing is an instant fail. Take it slow.
Flying directly above Pete's plane keeps you off radar.
If Donnie goes down you restart from the checkpoint, so prioritize enemies shooting at him.
The coffee table scene at the end is sometimes listed as its own mission, "Building a Life."

missions.title: Day Release
missions.summary: Lucia gets a night off from her ankle monitor and Mattia takes everyone out: a yacht party, a jetski race, a supercar chase and a club in Vice City.
steps: Meet the group at **The Rusty Anchor** bar.
Take the speedboat out to Mattia's **yacht**.
Race Mattia on jetskis back to the yacht.
As Lucia, shoot the champagne bottles out of the air in slow motion.
Pick a **dress** for Lucia, then find Mattia on the lowest deck.
Follow Mattia's supercar through Vice City.
Follow him into the **club** and join him in VIP, then dance with Jason.
Get out of the hotel over the balcony (jump into the pool) to escape security.
You wake up back in Key Lento as Jason.
objectives: Ride the jetski together with Jason (relationship boost)
Hit the dance prompts at the club (relationship boost)
tips: The jetski race result doesn't matter, so don't stress it.
If you wreck the car in the chase, reset it to fully repair it. The only way to fail the chase is destroying it.
The dress you choose is unlocked for Lucia permanently. It's the earliest free outfit in the game.

missions.title: Swamped
missions.summary: Brian takes you to the Kingfisher camp to settle things. It goes badly, and the Kingfishers grab Lori.
steps: Meet Brian at the marina and ride with him to the **Kingfisher camp** in the northwest swamps.
Follow Brian into the camp.
When it turns violent, fight your way out with Brian.
Take the **helicopter** and go after the Kingfishers who have Lori.
Shoot from the helicopter to take out her captors without hitting Lori.
Finish the chase by boat: pull right alongside Lori's boat and jump across.
Win the struggle to end the mission.
tips: Watch your aim around Lori. Hitting her fails the mission.
When the game prompts you, blow up the Kingfishers' truck to take out a lot of them at once.
Get very close to Lori's boat or the jump won't trigger.
Back home, tell Lucia about Brian's plans for a small relationship boost.

missions.title: Don Gone
missions.summary: Make it look like Donnie packed up and left town: clear out his trailer, then get rid of his car.
steps: Go to **Donnie's trailer** and take down his flag.
Pack up the marked items: his bag, the photo, his clothes, the flight schedule, the map on the fridge and his ID.
Leave the trailer and deal with the men from the bar (fight or run for the car).
Load the stuff into Donnie's car and drive out of Key Lento.
Find a quiet spot and **destroy the car** (gas can in the trunk, or shoot the engine).
Leave the area and call Brian.
tips: **Missable:** open the trunk before you destroy the car to grab a unique **.38 revolver**.
Hold L3 + R3 inside the trailer to highlight the items you need.
How you destroy the car doesn't matter.
missions.rewards: Unique .38 revolver (if you open the trunk first)

missions.title: Recalibration
missions.summary: Cal is taking things hard. Lucia sends Jason to cheer him up with beer, a fishing trip and a cookout.
steps: Buy a **six-pack** at the marked liquor store.
Drive to Cal's house and talk to him out back by the water.
Take the boat out to the fishing spot.
Catch the fish: cast, wait for a bite, then push the stick against the fish and reel it in.
Head back to Cal's dock and **grill** the fish, flipping them before they burn.
Serve the food, then go after Lucia when she leaves.
Drive Lucia home.
tips: Before you start: make a manual save in a NEW slot and move your cash into Family Savings (BuckMe). Cash you're carrying is lost, you lose Jason's Key Lento house, and there's no free roam again until Chapter 2.
Use the right stick to attract fish before you wait for a bite.

missions.title: Tourist Trap
missions.summary: Mattia's 'easy' job, grabbing a bag from a locker, is a setup. The police are waiting, and Jason gets badly hurt.
steps: Go to the **Visitor Center** and get the bag from the lockers.
Head back toward the car. You'll be arrested.
When the interrogation goes wrong, switch to **Lucia** and fight back.
Fight your way out of the building, picking up weapons as you go.
Get Jason to the dock while covering him.
Shoot the explosive canisters on the incoming vehicles.
Escape by boat into open water and head to Cal's.
tips: Before you start: make a manual save in a NEW slot and move your cash into Family Savings (BuckMe). Cash you're carrying is lost, you lose Jason's Key Lento house, and there's no free roam again until Chapter 2.
Stay close to Jason. If he dies the mission fails.
Use Focus Mode (L3 + R3) to spot explosives, which glow red.
Police you kill here are part of the story and don't count against your criminal profile.

missions.title: Home Sweet Home
missions.summary: Lucia goes back for Jason's things, but robbers hit the house and it goes up in flames. Then she has to slip past a police search.
steps: Enter Jason's house and fight off the two robbers.
Get out the front door before the house **explodes**.
Stay crouched in the dark and avoid the police.
Reach the main road through Key Lento.
Steal a car (or stay on foot) and get out of the search area.
tips: Don't go for the cash in the house. There isn't time.
Crouching in the dark keeps you hidden. A car is the fastest way out.

missions.title: Discharge Time
missions.summary: The Chapter 1 finale. Gunmen find Jason at the hospital and Lucia has to get him out, wheelchair and all.
steps: As Lucia, go to the second floor and find Jason's room.
As Jason in the wheelchair, shoot the attackers while Lucia pushes you out.
Clear the ambulance bay while Lucia goes for a vehicle.
When you're knocked down, crawl to the gun.
Ride in the back of the **ambulance** and shoot the cars chasing you.
Make it out to finish Chapter 1.
tips: Use Focus Mode in the hospital: enemies come in big groups.
Shoot tires and engines on the chase cars to cause pileups that clear the road.
If you get lost, ask the hospital receptionist where Jason is.

missions.title: What's in the Bag?
missions.summary: Laying low at a motel in Port Gellhorn while Jason heals, Lucia takes a look at what was in the stolen bag.
steps: Start at the **Starlet Motel** in Kelly County.
Look at the small statue and flip it over to read the note underneath.
Check the hard drive.
tips: Short mission. The hard drive can't be used yet, so it's just a story item for now.
Afterward you can explore the open world as Lucia.

missions.title: Just Moved In
missions.summary: Stock up the motel room with supplies from the store across the street.
steps: Go to the **Alpha** convenience store at the gas station across from the motel.
Pick up the 8 marked items: soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag.
Bring everything back to your room.
tips: Picking an item up pays for it. You don't need to talk to the clerk.
Turn on item markers in the UI settings to spot the items faster.

missions.title: Girls' Trip
missions.summary: Jason needs real painkillers. Vicki's pills turn out to be a dud, so she helps Lucia track down a dealer named Dunk.
steps: Ask Zach at the motel about painkillers. He sends you to **Vicki in Room 10**.
Pay Vicki **$50** for the pills and take them to Jason.
When they turn out to be over-the-counter, go back to Vicki.
Follow Vicki from the **Delights** club and get in her car.
Look for Dunk at his trailer, the boatyard, then the car wash.
Deal with the Kolts at the car wash and chase Dunk.
Drive Dunk back to his trailer.
tips: Pick **Defuse** twice at the car wash to skip the fight.
Dunk isn't at his trailer at first. His friends at the boatyard point you to the car wash.

missions.title: Moses
missions.summary: Mechanic Moses can set Lucia up with a car of her own, as long as it's one nobody is tracking.
steps: Follow Moses to the yard behind his garage.
Scan the three parked cars with the **WAiNK** app.
Grab the **Slim Jim** and use it on the marked car's door.
Head back to the garage. Steal a suitable car if you didn't bring one.
Respray the car, then register it.
tips: Cars with a standard or advanced tracker won't work for Moses. Scan first (hold Up on the D-pad).
Steal from the main road in central Port Gellhorn, not near the garage.
If your garage is full, sell a car first to free a slot.
missions.rewards: Slim Jim, Scooter Bros app, a free registered car, and selling cars to Moses (no daily limit)

missions.title: Ambulance Chaser
missions.summary: The ambulance from the hospital escape is still sitting nearby. Get rid of it before the police find it.
steps: Find the ambulance in the **barn east of the motel**.
Take the ATV and chase the ambulance when some addicts drive off in it.
Stay on it until it crashes into a tree.
Grab the gas can, pour the gas over the ambulance (R1/RB) and light it (Triangle/Y).
Get out of the area fast. The explosion draws the police.
tips: Don't crash during the chase.
If you have a gun, you can throw the gas can in and shoot it instead.

missions.title: Slam Dunk
missions.summary: Dunk's plan to get stronger painkillers from the Kolts goes sideways at the meet.
steps: Follow Dunk to the convenience store to meet **Dr. Bill**.
Ride with them to the docks and into the Kolts' compound.
Escape when the Kolts open fire, then lose them.
Catch up with Dr. Bill after he bails.
Drive to the airstrip southwest of Port Gellhorn and fight the Kolts, including the ones inside buildings.
Find Dunk in the central building and drive him home.
tips: Stay in cover at the airstrip and heal with **Zombix**.
Check every building. Some Kolts hide inside.
Searching Dr. Bill's body is optional but gives extra cash.
missions.rewards: Painkillers for Jason, Dunk becomes a fence, plus a BuckMe payment the next day

missions.title: Daily Driver
missions.summary: Moses wants a white '82 Canis Crawler taken back from clients who didn't pay.
steps: Wait for Moses's text with a photo of the car.
Go to the search area near the old **Trader's Union** building.
Find the white Crawler in the middle of the area.
Fight the guards or just get in and drive off.
Deliver it to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn.
tips: You don't have to fight. You can run straight to the car.
Bring it back **undamaged** for a bonus.
missions.rewards: $1,250 (+$500 if it's in good shape), the Port Gellhorn garage and the Vice City Real Estate app

missions.title: Breakfast Run
missions.summary: Jason's back on his feet. Breakfast at Hank's Waffles turns into a run of quick store robberies.
steps: Drive to **Hank's Waffles** and rob the diner (check both registers).
Hit the liquor store, the thrift store and the convenience store.
At the store with the glass booth, **kick** the door open.
Take down the clerk with the shotgun, then empty the register.
Rob the last liquor store.
Lose the 2-star wanted level and head back to the motel.
tips: Each stop has about a one-minute timer, so grab the cash and go.
At the shotgun store, crouch behind the shelves and let your partner cover you.

missions.title: Coffee Break
missions.summary: The morning after, Jason and Lucia plan one bigger score so they can move to Vice City.
steps: Walk with Lucia to the motel kitchen.
Buy her a $2 coffee from the machine.
Watch the planning scene, then go back to your car.
tips: After this you can **switch between Jason and Lucia** (R1/RB). Hold Right on the D-pad to give your partner commands.
Several optional jobs open up at once, and you can do them in any order.

missions.title: Afternoon Delight
missions.summary: Vicki has a proposal: help her rob the strip club she works at and split the cash.
steps: Get backstage at **Delights**. Jason climbs the fence out back once the bouncers move.
Choose whether to join the dancers on stage.
Crack the back-office safe and shoot your way out.
Lose the bikers chasing you.
Bring the cash to Vicki at the docks.
tips: **Safe code: 2008**
Dancing or not doesn't change the payout. Skipping it is faster, but the chase is harder.
Play pool at Delights before the next mission, while you still can.
missions.rewards: $10,000 from Vicki (via BuckMe the next day)

missions.title: Checking Out
missions.summary: The Chapter 2 finale. Armed men show up at the motel and Jason and Lucia have to fight their way out and run for Vice City.
steps: Pack up and answer the knock at the door.
Fight your way out of the room and across the parking lot.
As Lucia, hold the **motel kitchen** against several waves.
Chase Jason's convertible on a motorbike.
When you're right behind it, press **Jump** to land in the passenger seat.
Shoot the chasing SUVs until you're clear.
tips: **Point of no return:** the Starlet Motel stops being a safehouse after this. Save manually first and finish anything at Delights.
Guides recommend having **$15,000+** saved going in.
In the kitchen, stay crouched behind the counter. Standing by the windows gets you killed.

missions.title: Welcome to Vice City
missions.summary: Jason's old friend Dre'Quan sets you up at his club, and Boobie lends you an apartment in Bayside.
steps: Answer Dre'Quan's call on the highway.
Drive to the **Jack of Hearts** club in Crosstown and go around to the **back** entrance.
Tour the club with Dre'Quan, then go upstairs to meet **Boobie** and get the key.
Drive to Bayside, park in the **side lot**, and head up to apartment 201.
tips: The front door of the club is a dead end. Use the back.
The apartment objective won't move on until you park in the side lot.
The Bayside apartment is your safehouse for this chapter.

missions.title: Dealer's Choice
missions.summary: Boobie sends Jason and Dre'Quan to buy product from Tyrone and sell it in Crosstown.
steps: Pick a hook in the Jack of Hearts studio, then take the job in Boobie's office.
Drive to **Imperial Plaza** in La Perle and choose **pure or cut** product from Tyrone.
Hand the product to the buyers at the Crosstown community center.
Deal with their complaint, then lose the police.
Drop Dre'Quan in Southside and head back to the apartment.
tips: **Cut** pays more but the buyers complain. Offering half price avoids a fight but pays least.
If it turns into a shootout, use the parked cars as cover.
The Southside drop-off only appears after you lose the cops.

missions.title: Meet the Heders
missions.summary: Dinner with Brian and Lori leads to Raul, who wants a car stolen out of the port that night.
steps: Drive to the restaurant and meet Brian at the bar.
As Lucia, grab the uniform from the port van.
Check the yellow **SCOOP** containers until the tracker starts moving.
Chase the truck, jump onto the open container and reverse the car out.
Lose the 3-star wanted level and drop the car at Raul's lockup.
tips: Only the yellow SCOOP containers matter.
Stay right behind the open container until the Jump prompt appears.
Raul's lockup location only comes through once you've lost the police.

missions.title: Dubious Provenance
missions.summary: You take the statue from the stolen bag to an antique dealer in Capri, and it turns into a con.
steps: Take the statue to the antique store in **Capri**.
Decide whether to let **Halifax** appraise it (he leaves his watch as collateral).
Later, sneak in the back window and search the desk for the statue and a motel address.
Find Halifax at the motel, then chase him down by boat, on foot and by golf cart.
Choose whether to shoot or spare him.
tips: This mission comes in parts that unlock over time. If you decline the appraisal, a call-back objective appears. **Do it before Chapter 3 ends** or you lose the rest.
You must **trust Halifax** at the motel to unlock the last part.
Shooting or sparing him doesn't affect completion.
missions.rewards: A Crowex watch, about $2,500 in jewelry and cash, and the '32 Hustler car

missions.title: Mami Knows Best
missions.summary: Lucia helps her mom Mia check out a run-down house she's trying to sell, and the neighbors are trouble.
steps: Ride with Mia to the house in Hamlet.
Clear the junk off the lawn into the dumpster.
Help pull the mattress out of the pool and shoot the gator that grabs Mia.
Take the **excavator** across the street and wreck the gang's house and cars.
Drive Mia back to her office.
tips: Shoot the gator fast or Mia gets hurt.
Hold the claw button on the excavator to grab and smash cars.

missions.title: South Leonida Real Estate
missions.summary: Mia has been grabbed by the M7 gang, and Lucia has to get her back. Mia talks her way out by offering to find the gang's boss a new headquarters, but his lieutenant Viper has other plans.
steps: Track down Mia's kidnappers.
Follow the kidnappers' car **without being seen**.
Go along with Mia's pitch and tour the properties with the M7 boss.
When Viper turns on his boss, fight back and **defeat Viper**.
Leave with Mia once the gang lets you both go.
tips: This mission is played as Lucia only.

missions.title: Tyrone
missions.summary: Tyrone wants to know who's making a synthetic drug called 'kitty litter.'
steps: Meet Tyrone.
Get the name and address of a user, **Charles**, from Dook's text.

missions.title: Here, Kitty Kitty
missions.summary: Jason tracks down Charles, who leads him on a chase that ends badly.
steps: Go to Charles' apartment and get his neighbor to talk (pay or pressure him).
Search the apartment and grab the **thrift store receipt**.
Call Tyrone about the receipt, then go to the camp in the La Perle parking garage.
Chase Charles through the garage.
Search him for the pink baggie.
tips: There's no way to save Charles.
The garage camp only shows up after you call Tyrone about the receipt.
missions.rewards: Tyrone's lead on the kitty litter maker

missions.title: Car Service
missions.summary: Lucia steals a Schafter V12 out of a chop shop and delivers it to Randy.
steps: Get into the chop shop yard and find the **Schafter V12** in a garage bay.
Fight off the crew (watch for gunmen on the roofs).
Drive out and lose anyone chasing you.
Deliver the car to Randy at **Leonida Auto World**.
tips: Clear the crew before you get in the car.
Don't stop on the street after leaving the yard.
missions.rewards: Randy's number (he buys specific cars from you)

missions.title: Top Billing
missions.summary: The Real Dimez get bumped from their show, so Lucia tracks down Roxy and shuts down the party she went to.
steps: Go backstage at the Jack of Hearts.
Find the Dimez out back and follow Roxy's car across the tracks.
Grab food at **Peewees**, then drive to the house party in Salton.
Find Roxy in the bedroom and call Jason.
As Jason, cut the power at the **green electrical box** by the curb.
tips: You don't need to catch Roxy. The chase ends once she crosses the tracks.
The power box is on the street, not in the house.

missions.title: Boobie Time
missions.summary: Jason drives Boobie on his collections, and some kids steal the cash bag.
steps: Drive Boobie to the pickups on North Vice Ave and in Rockridge.
Take him to Big Mike's new club in Salton.
Chase the thief down the river on a **Seashark** and shoot until the bag drops.
Get the bag back (dive for it if it sinks) and return to Boobie.
Meet **Yasmani** at the Tropik Haze smoke shop.
tips: Jason only. If the mission marker doesn't show, switch to Jason.
If the bag sinks, get off at the marker and dive for it.
missions.rewards: Yasmani becomes a fence for hot goods

missions.title: First Impressions
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia act as the decoy in Raul's bank robbery, then cover his escape.
steps: Meet Raul and drive the getaway.
Lead the chase to the **Redwood Suites** garage.
Burn the car to get rid of prints and switch rides.
Drop Raul off in the alley by the gym.

missions.title: Caught Slipping
missions.summary: Burglars hit the apartment, so Jason and Lucia chase them down.
steps: As Jason, chase the first thief and shoot him in the legs.
Search his bag.
As Lucia, chase the second thief and do the same.
Meet Jason out front and drive to **Big House Storage**.
Follow Jason up to his storage unit.
tips: Use Focus Mode (L3 + R3) to hit their legs.
It starts on its own when you go back to the Bayside apartment after Boobie Time and First Impressions.

missions.title: Crosstown Traffic
missions.summary: Raul's next job: steal a cash transfer moving across town by train and river.
steps: As Lucia, follow the courier onto the **metro**.
Make him call in a new driver.
As Jason, grab the boat by the river and escape.
As Lucia, pull the **emergency brake** at the end of the carriage.
tips: If Lucia misses the train, grab a scooter and catch it at the next stop.
Pull the brake before the train reaches the gang on the tracks.

missions.title: Credit Check
missions.summary: Raul brings Jason and Lucia to his base and introduces his crew: Felipe the driver, Karim the tech expert and Andrea on comms and disguises. As a warm-up for something bigger, he sends them to rob three small bank branches.
steps: Drive to Raul's base and meet his crew.
Head to the first bank branch and rob it.
Rob the second branch.
Rob the third branch.
Escape the police after each job and lose your wanted level.
missions.rewards: Cash from the three bank jobs

missions.title: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy
missions.summary: Randy wants a heavily secured Grotti Zorrusso, and this job teaches you how to beat its security.
steps: Accept Randy's job.
Go to **Vice Beach** where the car is parked.
Scan it with **WAiNK** to check its locks and tracker.
Steal it and get it to Randy without wrecking it.
tips: An **advanced tracker** can tell the police where you are. Driving fast helps shake it.
Plan your escape route before you take the car.
missions.rewards: Unlocks the **Key Cloner** on your phone

missions.title: Sinfrontera National Bank
missions.summary: Raul reveals the real target: Sinfrontera National Bank, where a cartel washes its money. Jason and Lucia case the place before the heist planning begins.
steps: Drive to Sinfrontera National Bank.
Go inside and scope out the lobby as Lucia.
Spot every security feature in the bank.
Meet Raul and Andrea to go over what you found.
tips: Raul gives you a new lead afterwards: track down a bank security expert.
missions.rewards: Unlocks the next Cartel Heist setup mission

missions.title: Security Expert
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia pull Nicole away from her guards and bring her to Raul.
steps: Drive past the marked house slowly, then park nearby.
Sneak in behind Jason and wait for the guard to leave the back door.
Head to the bedroom and pick Nicole up.
Carry her out the side and put her in your trunk.
Lose the guards and drive to the planning room in Stockyard.
tips: Stay right behind Jason so the guards don't spot you.
Get away quickly once Nicole is in the trunk.

missions.title: Ride or Die
missions.summary: Dre'Quan needs a pair of hyped sneakers to get close to rival DWNPLY, and the plan ends with his car.
steps: Go upstairs at the sneaker drop and find someone carrying the **gold shoe bag**.
Haggle or intimidate them for the shoes, or grab a bag while the line is distracted.
Follow Dre'Quan to **DWNPLY** and have him sign the shoes.
Take his keys and steal his car, with DWNPLY still on the hood.
Drive out of the garage and get away.
tips: Once someone refuses you, that option's gone, so pick carefully.
If you fail a step, Dre'Quan has a backup plan, so you don't restart.
Stash anything illegal before you go home. The apartment can trigger the next mission.

missions.title: Company Property
missions.summary: Brian sets up a weapons shipment for Raul's heist through his smuggler contact, Pilot Pete. The drop at the airfield goes wrong when the law shows up.
steps: Meet Brian at the airfield.
Help Brian and Pete unload the shipment.
Get away when the police and IAA agents raid the airfield.
Escape the airfield with Pete.
Protect Brian's truck until the cargo is safe.
tips: The weapons from this job are used later in the Cartel Heist.
missions.rewards: Weapons cargo for the Cartel Heist

missions.title: The Missing Link
missions.summary: Andrea and Lucia go undercover to meet Monty, a senior cartel enforcer, at a rough underground event in Watson Bay. When the plan falls apart they bring him back to Vice City for questioning.
steps: Meet Andrea.
Go with Andrea to the meeting with Monty in Watson Bay.
Play along when Monty takes you to his photo room.
Fight your way out when the plan goes wrong.
Escape with Monty and drive him back to Vice City.
Help Raul's crew question Monty.
tips: This mission is played as Lucia only.

missions.title: Safe Word
missions.summary: To practice for the vault, the crew steals a smaller copy of the bank's safe from a mansion.
steps: Drive the truck to Gil's mansion in **Peacock Estates**.
As Jason, sneak in and blend in when you're stopped.
Find the safe remote in the **left desk drawer** of Gil's office.
Back the truck up, winch the safe out the window and drag it away.
Drag it to the garage, then practice cracking it at Raul's place.
tips: Avoid hitting people with the dragging safe or your profile goes Psycho.
When drilling, keep the gauge steady and don't let the light turn red.

missions.title: Cooties
missions.summary: Lucia helps Dre'Quan and the Dimez shoot a music video that trashes DWNPLY's car.
steps: Meet Dre'Quan in Crosstown.
Deal with the guys who come at Roxy.
Smash the car with the bat and spray-paint it.
Lose DWNPLY's crew and get out of the red zone.
Drop the car at the studio.
tips: Dre'Quan calls a couple of in-game days after Ride or Die.

missions.title: Bricked Up
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia find Boobie making himself at home in their apartment. He reminds them that living there means working for him, and sends them on a pickup that ends in a police raid.
steps: Return to the apartment and talk to Boobie.
Drive to the pickup location.
Collect the bag Boobie is owed.
Survive the police raid on the building.
Find a way out of the building and escape.
Lose the police.

missions.title: Hidden Charges
missions.summary: The last prep job before the Sinfrontera bank heist. Jason and Lucia plant explosives on cell towers around Vice City so the police are slowed down and the bank's emergency calls get cut on the day.
steps: Meet the crew in the planning room.
Head to the first marked cell tower.
Plant the explosives at the tower **without being spotted**.
Move on to the second tower and rig it the same way.
Rig the third and final tower.
tips: Destroying all three cell towers gives you just under 11 minutes on the heist timer.

missions.title: The Cartel Heist
missions.summary: The Chapter 3 finale: the crew hits Sinfrontera National Bank.
steps: Drive to the cell towers downtown and blow them.
Get to the bank, wait for Karim's signal and knock out a guard.
Herd the staff into the middle of the room and take the elevator to the vault floor.
Fight through security, then drill and open the **vault**.
Loot it (take the **bill stacks** first).
Hold off the police and SWAT, rescue Nicole and get out through the basement.
Steal the SWAT truck and protect the bus during the escape.
tips: Save manually before you start.
Shoot guns out of enemies' hands to keep a Professional rating.
Bill stacks are worth the most, so grab them before loose cash.
missions.rewards: $120,000 and the Break the Bank trophy

missions.title: Ocean Beach
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia trade the Bayside apartment for a five-star hotel on Ocean Beach.
steps: Pack up at the Bayside apartment.
Text Valentina and drive to **the Y** hotel.
Leave the car with the valet and meet Valentina in the lobby.
Check in to **room 701** and meet the concierge, Santino.
tips: Room 701 is your new base.
You get **BuckMe Premium** accounts here.

missions.title: Another Life
missions.summary: A flashback to Lucia's past, before the story began.
steps: Wait on hold with the power company.
Look after the baby while you wait.
Wake up on the hotel balcony the next morning.
tips: Nothing in this mission can be failed.
Afterward you're free to use the hotel pool and cabana.

missions.title: Company Cars
missions.summary: The hotel comes with perks, including a free car each.
steps: Ask Santino at the front desk about the hotel's services.
Drive to **Status Auto Imports** in Bayside and ask for Rob.
Each of you picks a car to keep.
Race each other back to the hotel.
tips: The free cars only come up once Santino lists the services.
missions.rewards: A free car each for Jason and Lucia

missions.title: Lawyer Up
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia go to lawyer Abe Gonzalez for help. His fix costs more than they have.
steps: Drive to Gonzalez's office.
Get past the receptionist by saying you're friends of **Valentina**.
Meet Gonzalez and hear about the Mega Mundo job.
Grab the hard drive from your storage unit.
tips: The receptionist won't let you up without the Valentina line.

missions.title: Party Hard
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia pose as security for Andrés de Leon at a Mega Mundo party, and it gets out of hand.
steps: Meet Andrés as his security detail.
Go along with his detours (like the juice bar) but keep him moving.
Get him to the **Mega Mundo** building for the speeches.
Find him hiding in a 24th-floor conference room.
tips: The job is keeping Andrés happy, so roll with his detours.

missions.title: Heavy Lifting
missions.summary: You bring Raul the hard drive, then spy on a rival crew at the Ajax Gym and learn they're planning something at the airport.
steps: Get the hard drive from storage and take it to **Raul's houseboat**.
Sail the houseboat south to **Ajax Gym**.
As Lucia, take the tour, change into gym clothes and search **Raina's** bag.
Finish the treadmill and leg-press sections.
Trap **Nate** in a tanning bed, search his bag and read his messages.
That night, tail the bodybuilders to the **Grand Majestic** and follow them up to the roof.
tips: While tailing, keep the arrow above them **white**. Yellow means you're too close.
Alternate the button prompts steadily on the treadmill.

missions.title: Photo/Shoot
missions.summary: A helicopter photo shoot for the Dimez turns into a rescue when Dre'Quan gets grabbed.
steps: Follow Dre'Quan up to the roof in Tequesta.
As Lucia, photograph the Dimez from the helicopter.
As Jason, fly the helicopter and follow Dre'Quan's car.
When the car goes into a building, switch to Lucia on the bike and keep up.
Shoot back at the cars that join the chase.
Fight your way to Dre'Quan under the highway and clear the alley.
tips: You can't shoot the car during the bike chase, so just follow it.
Clear every enemy in the alley or the mission won't end.

missions.title: Making Gainz
missions.summary: Raul's next plan sends Lucia to Ajax Gym to get close to Nate, a bodybuilder in Kordell's crew. She trains alongside him until he lets her into Kordell's private Trauma Floor.
steps: As Lucia, meet Raul to hear his plan.
Go to Ajax Gym and find Nate.
Get Nate's attention and work out alongside him.
Complete the workout montage.
Follow Nate to see Kordell's Trauma Floor.
Leave the gym.
tips: This is a Lucia-only mission.

missions.title: Watch It
missions.summary: Jason teams up with Dre'Quan to meet the owner of VYB, a Vice City nightclub, and hear what he needs.
steps: As Jason, go to the marker to meet Dre'Quan.
Ride with Dre'Quan to meet the owner of the VYB nightclub.
Listen to what the club owner needs from you.
Follow the on-screen objectives until the meeting wraps up and you leave the area.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.

missions.title: Cash Injections
missions.summary: Lucia backs Nate on a scheme to sell Synthol on Ocean Beach. In return, Nate promises to put in a good word for her with Kordell.
steps: As Lucia, meet up with Nate.
Head down to Ocean Beach with him.
Help Nate sell Synthol to people on the beach.
Finish the deal and wrap up with Nate.
missions.rewards: Nate agrees to vouch for Lucia with Kordell

missions.title: Amateur Hour
missions.summary: Cisco asks Lucia to help him confront a film director who owes him money. She goes along with it to win Cisco's trust inside Kordell's crew.
steps: As Lucia, finish your workout at the gym.
Talk to Cisco and agree to help him.
Go with Cisco to find the director.
Confront the director about the money he owes Cisco.

missions.title: Dirty Work
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia work together to deal with Raina, a member of Kordell's crew, as part of the setup for the airport heist.
steps: Meet up and go over the plan for dealing with Raina.
Play your part as Jason when the mission switches to him.
Play your part as Lucia when the mission switches to her.
Finish the plan to make new inroads with Kordell's crew.
tips: You play as both Jason and Lucia in this mission.
This is one of the setup missions for the VCIA Takedown heist.

missions.title: Too Much Baggage
missions.summary: Jason goes undercover at the airport as a baggage handler to scope it out for the VCIA Takedown heist.
steps: As Jason, head to the airport for your first shift.
Start work undercover as a baggage handler.
Handle the baggage jobs you're given.
Scope out the airport while you work.
Finish the shift and leave the airport.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.
This is one of the setup missions for the VCIA Takedown heist.

missions.title: Adventures in Babysitting
missions.summary: Jason takes a job working nightclub security for Andrés.
steps: As Jason, meet up with Andrés.
Go with Andrés to the nightclub.
Stay close to Andrés and keep him safe while he's at the club.
Follow the on-screen objectives until Andrés is safe.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.

missions.title: Fresh Evidence
missions.summary: Jason and Dre'Quan team up to steal a stash of blackmail material.
steps: As Jason, go to the marker to meet Dre'Quan.
Head with Dre'Quan to where the material is kept.
Get inside and find the blackmail material.
Steal the material and get away.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.

missions.title: Power Play
missions.summary: Help out Kordell's crew and gather some intel. This is one of the setup missions for the VCIA Takedown.
steps: Go to the marker to meet up with Kordell's crew.
Find out what intel the crew needs.
Travel to the area where the intel can be gathered.
Collect the intel.
Leave the area once you have it.
tips: Part of the VCIA Takedown setup chain.
Story missions can't be replayed from the menu, so finish objectives the first time.

missions.title: Child's Play
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia team up to help out an acquaintance.
steps: Go to the marker to start the mission with Jason and Lucia.
Find out what the acquaintance needs help with.
Head to the marked location together.
Deal with the trouble you find there.
Wrap things up with your acquaintance.
tips: Right after this mission, keep an eye out for the optional call "This Is a Free Call From…". It's time-sensitive and can be missed.
You can switch between Jason and Lucia by holding Right on the D-Pad.

missions.title: Headliners
missions.summary: The Dimez perform at VYB, and Jason and Lucia help make the launch party a success.
steps: Head to VYB nightclub for the launch party.
Help get things ready before the show.
Keep the party running while the Dimez perform.
Handle any problems that come up during the night.
tips: Both Jason and Lucia are playable here. Hold Right on the D-Pad to switch.

missions.title: Close Surveillance
missions.summary: Jason uses a spy drone to keep an eye on a group of bodybuilders. This is a VCIA Takedown setup mission.
steps: As Jason, go to the marker to start the mission.
Launch the spy drone.
Fly the drone to where the bodybuilders are.
Keep them under watch and gather what you can.
Finish the surveillance and leave the area.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.
Part of the VCIA Takedown setup chain.

missions.title: Delivery Method
missions.summary: Jason goes undercover to help Andrea. This is a VCIA Takedown setup mission.
steps: As Jason, go to the marker to meet Andrea.
Get into your undercover role.
Head to the location Andrea needs you at.
Do the job without blowing your cover.
Leave the area and check in with Andrea.
tips: This is a Jason-only mission.
Part of the VCIA Takedown setup chain.

missions.title: Team Building
missions.summary: Lucia meets Kordell and has to prove herself to his crew. This is a VCIA Takedown setup mission.
steps: As Lucia, go to the marker to meet Kordell.
Listen to what Kordell wants from you.
Complete the task he sets to prove yourself.
Return to Kordell once the job is done.
tips: This is a Lucia-only mission.
Part of the VCIA Takedown setup chain.

missions.title: Fully Catered
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia steal an airport catering truck for the VCIA Takedown heist. It's the last vehicle prep before the airport job.
steps: Head to the marker with Jason and Lucia.
Find the airport catering truck the crew needs.
Steal the truck without wrecking it.
Drive it to the drop-off point marked on the map.
Park the truck and leave the area to finish the prep.
tips: Part of the VCIA Takedown setup chain.
Drive carefully on the way back so the truck isn't too damaged for the heist.

missions.title: VCIA Takedown
missions.summary: The airport heist at Vice City International. Raul's crew turns on Kordell's crew and goes after the haul, and things get messy fast.
steps: Meet up with the crew to start the heist.
Head to Vice City International Airport.
Follow Raul's plan to intercept Kordell's crew and their haul.
Fight your way through when the plan turns violent.
Make your escape with the money.
Get away from the airport and lie low.
tips: Finishing it earns the **Hi-Jacked** trophy.
Finish all the prep missions first.
Make a manual save before this mission. Story missions can't be replayed.

missions.title: Sunset
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia go looking for Raul after the heist. They learn Valentina has sold him out and reach him at his houseboat too late.
steps: Go to the Y Hotel and stop by the front desk.
Pick up the message left for you.
Follow it to Raul's houseboat.
Watch Raul's final scene and learn about Valentina's betrayal.
Leave the houseboat and get clear of the area.
tips: This is a heavy story mission with very little combat until the end.

missions.title: Starting from Zero
missions.summary: With the police after them and their bank accounts frozen, Jason and Lucia grab what they have left: the hard drive and the statue. The chapter ends with them meeting shipping magnate Giorgio Gallo.
steps: Lie low and stay away from the police.
Collect the hard drive.
Go to the storage spot and retrieve the statue.
Follow the message to the meeting.
Meet Giorgio Gallo to end Chapter 4.
tips: **Point of no return:** save manually before this one. The story branches toward more than one ending.
Finishing it unlocks the **Top of the World, Ma** trophy.
Make another manual save once Chapter 5 starts.

missions.title: Bird in the Hand
missions.summary: Giorgio Gallo explains how the hard drive was used to blackmail Senator Camila Fuentes, then brings Jason and Lucia in on his next job. They scope out the Coast Guard headquarters and steal a helicopter.
steps: Go to Giorgio's penthouse and hear his plan.
Meet the crew Giorgio has brought in.
Head out and scope out the Coast Guard headquarters.
Go to Mile Zero Air Station.
Steal the helicopter and fly it away.
tips: First mission of Chapter 5.
Vinny joins the story here.

missions.title: Taking Liberties
missions.summary: A short, story-focused mission. Jason and Lucia meet Giorgio at his spa, where he offers them presidential pardons in return for their help, before a mob enforcer interrupts with an ultimatum: Giorgio gets one last chance.
steps: Head to Giorgio's building and find him in the **spa**.
Talk with Giorgio, who offers Jason and Lucia **presidential pardons** in exchange for their help.
Stay for the meeting when an unexpected visitor from the mob interrupts.
Listen to the ultimatum: Giorgio gets **one last chance** to make things right.
The mission ends once the meeting wraps up.
tips: This one is mostly a story scene, so there's no combat to prepare for.
Make a **manual save** before each Chapter 5 mission, since the finale missions come quickly from here.

missions.title: VC Baby
missions.summary: Back at Giorgio's penthouse, Kat suddenly goes into labor. Mattia turns to Jason and Lucia for help, and it's up to you to answer.
steps: Head to Giorgio's penthouse and **talk to Mattia**.
Stay with the group as Kat goes into labor.
**Follow Mattia** when the prompt appears.
Listen as Mattia asks Jason and Lucia for help.
Respond to his request and complete the objectives that follow to finish the mission.
tips: Make a **manual save** before starting. Chapter 5 missions come quickly from here.
Finish this and Doggie Bag to move on to **Operation Savage Glory**.

missions.title: Doggie Bag
missions.summary: Playing as Lucia, you team up with Vinny to steal Rocco, the Coast Guard's top sniffer dog. The plan is to get the Coast Guard searching a cruise ship at the port, grab Rocco during the search and get away by air.
steps: Meet up with Vinny as Lucia.
Head to the port with Vinny.
Get the Coast Guard to search the cruise ship docked there.
Slip onto the cruise ship while the search is underway.
Find Rocco and take him.
Get Rocco to the helicopter with Vinny.
Fly away to escape.
tips: Grabbing Rocco doesn't end the mission. You still have to reach the helicopter and get away.
Rocco's nose is the crew's way to find the rival shipment in the next missions.

missions.title: Operation Savage Glory
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia team up with Giorgio's crew to wipe out the rival shipment and then take back Giorgio's seized cargo from the Coast Guard. Afterwards, Giorgio pulls strings to get the police search for the couple called off.
steps: Meet up with Giorgio's crew to start the operation.
Track down the rival shipment.
Destroy the rival cargo.
Head to the Coast Guard headquarters.
Recover Giorgio's seized cargo for his crew.
tips: Finishing it unlocks the **Snow Storm** trophy.
Afterwards Giorgio sends Jason and Lucia to meet Abe, which leads into Protective Custody.

missions.title: Protective Custody
missions.summary: After a meeting with Abe, Giorgio double-crosses Jason and Lucia and they are taken into custody separately. Prosecutor Danica Howard wants Giorgio's hard drive, and both of them have to fight off corrupt officers before facing Mendez.
steps: Go to the meeting with Abe.
Giorgio turns on you, and Jason and Lucia end up held in separate places.
Listen to prosecutor Danica Howard: she needs Giorgio's hard drive.
Survive the attacks from corrupt officers as both Jason and Lucia.
Confront Mendez to finish the mission.
tips: Make a manual save in a fresh slot when this one ends. The next mission is the finale, and it decides your ending.

missions.title: The End of the Road
missions.summary: Jason and Lucia storm Giorgio's tower to take back the hard drive, then try to get away with the police closing in. The mission ends with the game's final choice.
steps: Assault Giorgio's tower and get into the penthouse.
Recover the hard drive.
Fight your way back out of the building with the drive.
Drive toward Cal's place, where a boat is waiting.
When the police get tipped off, change course and head for the airfield.
At the police roadblock on the bridge, make the final choice: **Swim for it** or **No Surrender**.
tips: Finishing it earns the **You Gotta Know When to Get Off** trophy.
**Save in a new slot first.** The bridge choice decides the ending, and you'll want to go back and see the other one.
Finish anything that needs both Jason and Lucia before you start.

missions.title: Shirley's Errands
missions.summary: Jason's neighbor Shirley needs a couple of favors around Key Lento.
steps: **Get Shirley's Rum:** buy a bottle at Three Sheets Liquor and bring it to her.
Out back of the store, deal with the guards by the parrot cages, then check the vent by the generator for about $1,300.
**Steal the Scooter:** about a day later she calls. Get her scooter back from a neighbor's yard and return it.
tips: **Missable:** both errands disappear once you start *Tourist Trap*.
They don't count toward 100% or trophies, but the cash is worth it.

missions.title: Skunk Ape Hunt
missions.summary: Cryptid hunter Kirk is sure the Skunk Ape is real, and he wants your help proving it.
steps: Read Kirk's flyer at **Skeeter's bar in Hamlet** and call him.
**Search for the Skunk Ape:** meet him at night near Thorp Adventures in Pelican Valley.
**Search for Tree Effigies:** find the three carved effigies in Pelican Valley.
**Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove:** a night-time helicopter chase near Cottonmouth Lake.
tips: Several parts only work at night. Sleep to skip ahead.
Counts toward the **Strangers & Freaks** trophy (8 strands needed).
missions.rewards: $1,000 for the first hunt, plus more cash later

missions.title: Treasure Dives
missions.summary: Kenton gives you a boat and a scanner to dive shipwrecks for his treasure sets.
steps: Visit **Kenton's dive shop** in Key Lento after *Island Dreams*.
Dive to the wrecks marked with purple chest icons and scan for loot.
Bring each finished set back to Kenton. More sets unlock in later chapters.
tips: Kenton pays after he sells what you find, so the money comes later.
5 of the 7 sets count toward 100%.
missions.rewards: Cash per set. Finish all 7 for the **This Was No Boat Accident** trophy

missions.title: Crop Duster Jobs
missions.summary: Farmer Kyle needs a pilot to dust his fields.
steps: Grab the pilot job flyer, then head to **McKittrick Farm**.
**Check Out McKittrick Farm:** fly low over the fields, following his truck.
**Collect Chemicals for Kyle.**
**Buddy?:** check on Kyle (the last part opens in Chapter 3).
tips: Counts toward the **Strangers & Freaks** trophy (8 strands needed).

missions.title: Steal Vehicles for Moses
missions.summary: After the *Moses* story mission, he buys untracked cars from you.
steps: Scan cars with **WAiNK** and skip any with a tracker.
Steal on Port Gellhorn's main road, not right next to his garage.
Drive it to Moses's garage to sell. Repeat as often as you like.
tips: There's **no daily limit**, just a short wait between sales.
Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
missions.rewards: $1,000+ per car, plus the Scooter Bros app

missions.title: Bret Vogel: Hunting
missions.summary: Hunting guide Bret takes Jason out, then gives him a deck of targets to hunt down.
steps: Answer Bret's text after *Coffee Break*. His hunting business is in Lummox County near Mount Kalaga.
**Veteran Hunted:** your first hunt with Bret.
**Bret's Hunting Decks:** 15 decks, each asking for a specific animal.
tips: One clean shot to the head or heart keeps the carcass **pristine** and pays more.
Lost the rifle? Pick it up again from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
missions.rewards: Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and the **Fair Game** trophy

missions.title: Billy: Dirt Bike Crew
missions.summary: Billy's dirt bike crew at the Thrillbilly Mud Club has a string of stunts and jobs.
steps: Head to the **Thrillbilly Mud Club** in Kelly County after *Coffee Break*.
Play through *Thrillbillies*, *Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab*, *Mall Rats* and *The Impaler*.
Finish with *Hometown Heroes* (go solo and leave your partner home).
tips: Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
missions.rewards: Prize money and **The Lone Rider** trophy

missions.title: Yago: Street Races
missions.summary: Street racer Yago brings Jason into the Vice City racing scene.
steps: Meet the **Hit 'n' Run VC** racers in Salton for *Join a Street Race* (either character).
*Bumper to Bumper:* mentor Yago.
**Race Against Yago:** do it the moment it appears.
*Brother to Brother:* back Yago up. It ends on a heavy story scene.
tips: **Missable:** *Race Against Yago* has an hourglass icon, so it's timed. Save first and race right away.
Counts toward the **Strangers & Freaks** trophy (8 strands needed).
missions.rewards: Race winnings (about $3,800 for first place against Yago)

missions.title: Andy's Cellerica
missions.summary: Lucia's old friend Andy gets her caught up in Cellerica, a pyramid scheme.
steps: Answer Andy's call after *Top Billing* and visit her new place in Belville.
*Climbing the Cellerichain* (3 parts) and *Pay the Cellerica Fee*.
*Peach!* and *Read the Label*.
Wrap up at the warehouse in *Puff Puff Pass*.
tips: Lucia only.
Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.

missions.title: Yasmani: Robbery Jobs
missions.summary: Fence Yasmani sets you up with robbery work around Vice City.
steps: **Jewelry jobs:** rob the cases *and* the back-room safe, then fence the loot with Yasmani.
**ATM jobs.**
**Payday Loans jobs:** do two to unlock his van tips.
**Tail the Security Van:** follow it to a bank vault.
tips: Jewelry stores pay $10,000–$25,000 each. Leave before the police show up.
Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
missions.rewards: Snap Gun, a fence for hot goods, and big robbery payouts

missions.title: Randy's Wish List
missions.summary: Randy wants specific high-end sports cars, delivered in perfect condition.
steps: Finish *Steal the Zorrusso for Randy* to get the **Key Cloner**.
Find the cars on his list. Randy marks some, and you can text him for tips.
Deliver each one undamaged to his garage in west Vice City.
tips: Damage cuts the payout, so drive carefully.
Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
missions.rewards: $30,000+ per car and the **Supply & Demand** trophy (16 cars)

missions.title: Tyrone: Kitty Litter Labs
missions.summary: Tyrone wants the labs making 'kitty litter' shut down for good.
steps: Unlocks after *Here, Kitty Kitty*.
**Take Out Kitty Litter:** hit the labs marked in purple around Vice City.
**Spin On This:** finish shutting them down.
tips: Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.

missions.title: Pilot Pete: The Last Mile
missions.summary: Pilot Pete calls Jason with flying work out of Leonida's small airfields.
steps: Answer Pete's call. The first job starts at **Sundown Airfield** in Leonard County.
*The Last Mile: Passing the Torch:* recover Pete's plane.
*The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot.*
*Pete's Deliveries* (Southpoint Airfield, Avery Allen & Co.), then *Deliver Packages*.
tips: Later drops fly from Wild Hog, Southpoint, Kelly County and Leonard County airfields.
Counts toward the **Strangers & Freaks** trophy (8 strands needed).

missions.title: Eddie Acosta's Party
missions.summary: After meeting him in *Pool Day*, Eddie invites you to one of his parties.
steps: Wait for Eddie's invite after *Pool Day*.
Go to the party.
tips: Short and optional.
Doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.
